correctness.rationale: The one-to-one encoding of size-(n−1) matchings by (pi,h) is valid: exactly one row and column are unused. The two legal slides for every r≠h either move the row hole to r or keep it, and both swap pi(h) with pi(r). I reconstructed the cycle-count potential Phi=n−c(pi)+2q_H(pi)+2ε; its ±1 change across each legal move is checked by merge/split cases, and the four non-source cases (h=H H nontrivial; h=H H fixed and other cycle; h≠H hole fixed; h≠H hole nonfixed) supply a one-unit descent. This proves equality with graph distance at every n≥2, beyond small BFS. Cycle-length optimization with parity-specific transposition witnesses yields exact floor(3n/2)−1 diameter and radius. Independently rebuilt BFS n=2..5 with 4,18,96,600 states and diameters 2,3,5,6; checks cannot replace the infinite proof.
